newsitem.title: UK: Rank in talks to sell Shearings to mbo.
newsitem.headline: Rank in talks to sell Shearings to mbo.

text.p: British leisure company The Rank Group Plc said on Monday it was in exclusive negotiations to sell its Shearings coach holiday business to a venture capital-backed management team.
A new company has been formed by NatWest Ventures Limited in conjunction with a Shearings management team, it said.
In a statement, Rank gave no other details of the planned sale which it had first announced in July.
The July statement had noted that the former managing director of Rank's Holidays division, Angus Crichton-Miller, had resigned to pursue an offer for the business.
